{{Quote|Not much to it. Barely populated, some old ruins scattered around, the usual grumpy wildlife you'd expect. People call it the Endless Swamp.|Koth Vortena|<ref name="KOTFE4" />}}
The '''Endless Swamp''' was located on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Zakuul]], named by the natives for its sheer size, it was scarcely populated and devoid of any technology.<ref name="KOTFE4" /> It was home to many immigrated variants of some creatures, including the [[Mawvorr]] from [[Voss]],<ref name="Mawvorr">{{TORcite|type=codex|Mawvorr}}</ref> the [[Wingmaw/Legends|Wingmaw]] from [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]],<ref name="Wingmaw">{{TORcite|type=codex|Wingmaw}}</ref> the [[Lurker/Legends|Lurkers]], who were believed to have originally come from an unnamed planet near the [[Torch Nebula/Legends|Torch Nebula]],<ref name="Lurker">{{TORcite|type=codex|Lurker}}</ref> and the [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]] from [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="Rancor">{{TORcite|type=codex|Rancor}}</ref> The only known native species was the arachnid [[Iknayid]].<ref name="KOTFE4" />

==History==
{{Quote|Thought you could hide in the swamps? Pathetic!|Captain Draynon Artus|<ref name="KOTFE5">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=5}}</ref>}}
Over a thousand years before the [[Galactic War]],<ref name="Koth">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=4}} &mdash; the player character places an estimate of one thousand years and over that the ''Gravestone'' has been in the Endless Swamp, and Koth Vertona confirms this</ref> the ''[[Gravestone]]'', said to have been the only [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to have ever gone up [[Battle against the Eternal Fleet|against]] the [[Eternal Fleet]] and achieved victory, was scuttled by it's owners in the eastern Endless Swamp. It would remain there for the next few centuries.<ref name="KOTFE4" />

[[File:Iknayid_swarm.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A swarm of Iknayids native to the Endless Swamp.]]
In [[3631 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|4.0}}</ref> [[Alliance Commander|The Commander]], convicted of the assassination of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Tenebrae|Valkorion]] was rescued from Emperor [[Arcann]]'s [[Arcann's storehouse|storehouse]] by [[Lana Beniko]], [[Koth Vortena]], [[HK-55]] and [[T7-O1]].<ref name="KOTFE3">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=3}}</ref> However, their [[Transport/Legends|transport]] was shot down in the Endless Swamp. HK-55 detected a 'large metallic object', and the group, minus T7, who were in dire need of transport off Zakuul, decided to investigate. Discovering the ''Gravestone'', which was in a surprisingly good condition, The Outlander helped Vortena scavenge starship parts and a fuel cell, and assisted Lana in finding a functioning water filter. Not finding any functioning filters, they instead discovered a fresh water spring. HK-55 located a camp of exiles, who had protested Arcann's rule, and were on the run from the [[Eternal Empire]]. The Outlander faced the dilemma of assisting them and allowing them onto their ship or not offering any aid. Vortena then started work on the ''Gravestone'', and, after some hassle, got it operational.<ref name="KOTFE4" />

Just as they were about to leave the planet, they came under [[Assault on the Gravestone|attack]] from the Eternal Empire's [[Skytrooper]]s and the [[Knights of Zakuul]]. Aided by [[Senya Tirall]], who arrived by [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]], the group defeated the opposition.<ref name="KOTFE5" /> The [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]], Lana and Senya, used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to lift the ''Gravestone'' out of the muck,<ref name="Force-sensitive">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' The Outlander may or may not be a Force-sensitive, depending on the player's choices. This article assumes that only Lana and Senya lifted the ''Gravestone'', as shown from a non-Force sensitive player's perspective, lest The Outlander be any of the four player classes without the Force.</ref> and they proceeded to leave the planet.<ref name="KOTFE5" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Swamp_of_Zakuul_Full.jpg|thumb|250px|Concept art of Endless Swamp]]
The Endless Swamp appears in chapters four and five of [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']], a [[2015]] digital expansion to the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="KOTFE4" /><ref name="KOTFE5" />
